changes.before: Backups of the customer database are taken every night, but a restore was never tested. It is unknown whether the data can be recovered within the time that the business accepts.
changes.after: Backups of the customer database are taken every night, but a restore was never tested. It is unknown whether the data can be recovered within the time that the business accepts. The first restore test on a copy of the database is planned for next quarter and must show a recovery time below four hours.
